citation: Hunter KT II, Lopez AR, Yun KL. Emergent Cardiopulmonary Bypass for a 180 Kilogram Patient: Support with a Single Oxygenator. J Extra Corpor Technol. 2013;45(3):178–182. PMID:24303600.
extraction: Manual transcription of selected numerical facts from the public article, checked against Table 1. Time in minutes converted to seconds. No chart digitization or raw monitor export.
rights: Article copyright AMSECT 2013. Selected numerical facts only; article prose, images and full tables are not redistributed. Repository MIT license applies to our code, not the source article.
saturation_status: Arterial saturation is not supplied in Table 1. Mixed venous saturation is a different variable and is deliberately not substituted.
missing_for_dynamic_validation: time-resolved fluid additions, vent return and ultrafiltration
sensitivity_status: Chosen arithmetic sensitivity endpoints, not measured saturation, confidence limits, or guaranteed physiologic bounds.
